We have relevant excerpts from DOC-042 parts 1-3. Part 1 says: By default, the response-time metric on the dashboard counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered, including nights, weekends and holidays — it is a wall-clock measurement, not a business-hours one.

Thus answer: Yes, by default it includes weekends and holidays. Also mention you can configure business-hours version in settings to exclude them. Provide short answer.
